tools.name: url-change-check
tools.description: Fetch a public https URL, compute SHA-256 of the response body, and report whether it changed vs a prior sha256/etag ($0.01 USDC via x402). Sticky: store sha256 and call again later. Optional previous_sha256, previous_etag, include_body_if_changed. https only — http, file, data, localhost, and priva

errors.title: Tool description changed since last scan
errors.detail: Tool "url-change-check" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
